name: Infogram
tagline: Infogram is a data visualisation and infographic tool designed for communicators who need clear, visual storytelling from complex data. Its AI suggests chart types based on your data structure and a smart layout engine keeps visuals consistent and professional. Journalists, marketers, and educators use it to turn spreadsheets into shareable, interactive graphics.
